== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Opening note cut: "Index of selected Players Committee (PC) rules changes with before/after comparisons. Prefer dated primary or archived announces." (lead rewritten as a plain definition)
* Layout inspiration cut: LOTR-TCG Player's Council wiki ruling pages, [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Legacy_Ruling_1 Legacy Ruling 1] (problem wording → dated decision → final text / where incorporated); card errata use the Original / Errata / Current pattern of [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/PC_Errata/Table PC Errata/Table]. These two links were also in the Sources list.
* "How to use this hub" section cut (editor instructions): each seed entry is one dated PC announcement or ruling package; expand by adding new === sections and linking card-level errata pages under [[Errata]] / [[PC Errata]].
* Index table: "Status on this wiki" column ("Seeded from PC announce") and the entry-count line removed.
* Cut from Where incorporated: "(verify current persona / Sidious wording there for play). This wiki page summarizes the announce; it is not a substitute for the rulebook."
* Cut from the before/after intro: "they are not invented rulebook quotes".
* Cut: "See the primary post for full example text." and "PC divergent-errata gap documented" (Errata on Projective Telepathy bullet).
* Sources list removed; the announce and its Wayback copy were already in ref personas2021.

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New section "Announcements of 2006–2008". Sources used: the swccgpc.com news index of June 2006 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220030/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic Internet Archive]); the Rules Committee news topic ([https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153935/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&new_topic=7 Internet Archive]); "Errata to [v11] Restricted Access" (17 April 2008, [https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072016/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=84 Internet Archive]); "Rules Info For Virtual Set 16" (15 August 2008, [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211146/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=95 Internet Archive]).
=== Missing data ===
* The full text of "Rules Changes – Characteristics" (20 December 2007) was not captured; only its summary is used. The Current Rulings and Errata thread itself was not captured either.
* The card-specific errata (Restricted Access (V)) and the Virtual Set 16 card rulings in the same posts belong on card pages and were not added here.
